source.basis: Operator facility page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

reading.body:
DataBank McLean IAD2 in McLean, Virginia, publishes 3 MW of IT capacity across 40,690 square feet of technical space, operated by DataBank.

At 10 kW per rack, a common enterprise colocation density, that load supports roughly 300 racks. At 40 kW per rack, a density closer to AI training workloads, it supports roughly 75 racks. The operator has not published a per-rack power envelope, so neither figure is the operator's own claim, only what the published megawattage implies under each assumption.

No compliance certifications are published for DataBank McLean IAD2. That does not mean none exist, only that this site's dataset, built from the operator's own facility page, does not list any, which limits what regulated workloads a reader could confirm the facility is qualified to host.

Virginia has 26 facilities mapped in this site's dataset, of which 20 publish a megawatt figure, totaling 1338.6 MW. DataBank McLean IAD2 contributes 3 MW of that total. At that published size it is a small facility relative to what frontier AI training infrastructure requires, which now runs into the tens or hundreds of megawatts, though it may still support inference workloads or smaller-scale AI applications.
